## Checks

- [ ] Tests added or updated; a bug fix has a test that fails on the old code
- [ ] `make check` passes (ruff, ty, deptry, full test suite)
- [ ] No behaviour change in a refactor, shown by comparing old and new on real data
- [ ] New or changed code follows `CLAUDE.md` (names, docstrings, vectorised, one focus per module)
- [ ] Commit messages are conventional, with no AI co-author trailer
